style: Create original fantasy pixel art with crisp 1px dark ink-teal outlines on the logical pixel grid, large readable clusters, and a limited palette. Both feet remain planted on a ground line at 94 percent of each cell height. Reserve at least 6 percent transparent margin on every side of each cell, containing all hair and weapon tips. Only subtle breathing and hair and weapon sway, no independent breast motion, no shield activation, no attack trail. Preserve identical anatomy, costume placement, weapon shape, camera and scale in all cells. Use crisp logical pixels enlarged in 4-pixel blocks.
